name: Roth.sqrt_lt_nat_floor_aux
body:
have hfloor : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ⌊X⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_floor hX
  (Real.sqrt_lt' (by positivity)).2 (by nlinarith only [Nat.lt_floor_add_one X, hfloor])
what: The natural floor of a real at least two strictly exceeds its square root.
how: Use Nat.le_floor and Nat.lt_floor_add_one to compare squares via Real.sqrt_lt'.
